summary: Braskem S.A. furnished a routine Form 6-K containing Brazilian CVM Resolution 44/2021 securities-trading disclosure forms for October 2026, covering the controlling shareholder Petrobras and Braskem management/board. Reported items are ordinary open-market and tender-offer share acquisitions at R$9.24 per Class A preferred share plus small spot sales, with opening and closing balances disclosed for common and preferred shares. No corporate action, transaction structure, premium, recommendation, advisor, or closing date is stated. This maps to a US Form 4-style insider holdings notice; no special-situation angle applies.
